variables.meaning: the first unknown of a linear equation in two or three unknowns, the first coordinate of a point (x, y) or (x, y, z)
the second unknown of a linear equation in two or three unknowns, the second coordinate of a point (x, y) or (x, y, z)
the third unknown of a linear equation in three unknowns, the third coordinate of a point (x, y, z)
the unknowns x₁, x₂, …, xₙ of a linear equation in n unknowns, also called its variables
the coefficients a₁, a₂, …, aₙ of a linear equation, the real numbers multiplying its unknowns
the constant on the right-hand side of a linear equation a₁x₁ + a₂x₂ + … + aₙxₙ = b
the number of unknowns in a linear equation
row equivalence: the matrices on either side are related by a sequence of scaling, interchange, and replacement operations
a matrix; in Sage, the matrix given that name, whose reduced row echelon form A.rref() finds; in the Augmentation Principle, the matrix that B augments
an augmentation of the matrix A, obtained from A by adding some more columns
the number of rows and of columns of a square matrix, the measure of its size in counting the effort of row reduction
a matrix; in Sage, the matrix given that name, whose reduced row echelon form A.rref() finds; in the Augmentation Principle, the matrix that B augments
the values s₁, s₂, …, sₙ that a solution assigns to the unknowns x₁, x₂, …, xₙ
